label: Aristotle, Physics III.1, 201a10-11: A… supports Being moved in r is the actualization, qua…
note: Physics III.1, 201a10-11 says motion is the actuality of the potential as such. The premise replaces 'the potential' by 'an unactualized capacity' (able to be r and not r in act), which is the Metaphysics IX.6 reading of potency, not something 201a10-11 states.
